title: SPVR: syntax-to-prompt vulnerability repair based on large language models
note: Abstract-only; rules extract syntax-tree info + CWE description into NL prompts for ChatGPT-4; compared against fine-tuning/prompt baselines, representation not isolated.

title: Code Vulnerability Repair with Large Language Model using Context-Aware Prompt Tuning
note: Full-text (HTML); progressively injects textual vuln-disclosure/CWE-detail context into Copilot prompts (15%->63% repair rate); context quantity varied, not a budget-controlled representation ablation.

title: Benchmarking LLMs and LLM-based Agents in Practical Vulnerability Detection for Code Repositories
note: Full-text (HTML); benchmarks Plain LLM (raw text) vs Dep-Aug LLM (retrieved callers/callees) vs ReAct Agent (get_callers/get_callees/get_definition tool calls for interprocedural context); no context-budget-matched representation-only ablation.

title: Minimizing False Positives in Static Bug Detection via LLM-Enhanced Path Feasibility Analysis
note: Full-text (HTML); CFG-derived branch conditions plus source-sink function call trace fed to an LLM agent that iteratively converts constraints to SMT and invokes Z3; ablations (NoContext, BatchSol) are component-level, not representation-isolated; beats baselines by 41-106%.

title: VULSOLVER: Vulnerability Detection via LLM-Driven Constraint Solving
note: Full-text (HTML); SAST extracts JSON-structured main source-to-sink paths plus caller-callee branch trees, serialized into per-subtask LLM prompts for constraint solving; component ablations (branch analysis, context maintenance), not representation-isolated; 97.85% OWASP accuracy + 15 zero-days found.

title: LLM-Driven Adaptive Source-Sink Identification and False Positive Mitigation for Static Analysis
note: Full-text (HTML); LLM classifies source/sink over code snippets + static path-feasibility features, then a neuro-symbolic validation step prunes infeasible flows against program facts/constraints; component-level ablations, compared to CodeQL/Joern/IRIS baselines (-43.7% FP, +11.2% recall).

title: An Empirical Evaluation of LLM-Based Approaches for Code Vulnerability Detection: RAG, SFT, and Dual-Agent Systems
note: Abstract-only; empirically compares RAG (CWE/internet knowledge retrieval, best F1=0.85), SFT (QLoRA adapters), and Dual-Agent auditing against a baseline LLM; representation and integration mechanism confounded across the three arms, not budget-isolated.

title: VulnAgent-R2: Evidence-Calibrated Multi-Agent Auditing for Repository-Level Vulnerability Detection
note: Full-text (HTML); role-specialized agents tool-read a heterogeneous repository graph (AST∪CFG∪DFG∪CALL∪IMP∪TEST∪HIST, built via tree-sitter/Joern-CPG/CodeQL/Semgrep) plus compile/test verification; bootstrap-tested gains over prior VulnAgent-X across 5 datasets, no representation-only ablation.

title: QASecClaw: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach for False Positive Reduction in Static Application Security Testing
note: Abstract-only; a Mission Orchestrator coordinates specialized agents (SAST filter, security validation, evidence correlation) that review SAST findings with raw source-code context; F1 90.93% vs standalone Semgrep 78.39%, no representation isolation.

title: RAVEN: Agentic RAG for Automated Vulnerability Repair
note: Abstract-only; agentic RAG pipeline retrieves historically relevant fixes and a Curator Agent retrieves cross-file dependencies to guide patch generation; 83.13% repair success outperforming SOTA frameworks, no ablation isolating retrieval/representation contribution.

title: AgenticRepair: Multi-Faceted Program Context Engineering for Agentic Vulnerability Repair
note: Abstract-only; three specialized subagents engineer co-primary contexts (cross-file dataflow/memory-op structure, runtime crash semantics, commit history) embedded into a repair subagent's memory; facet-level ablation (73% vs ~44% on SEC-Bench) conflates representation with context quantity.
